human.problem: Several lines in the passage speak of the LORD in the third person, so the prophet seems to be speaking: 12:2 "The LORD has a charge", 12:6 "return to your God", 12:13 "the LORD brought Israel" and 12:14 "his Lord will leave". human.question: In prophetic passages, can lines that refer to the LORD in the third person be presented as the LORD speaking, because card 1 says He speaks through the prophet? Or should Papa Dorin attribute them to the prophet, or leave the speaker open?
